name: Guillaume de la Descorde
vampire_desc: Second son of a marcher lord who built power through feuds and shifting alliances

experiences: Born in 1182 to a minor marcher lord near a disputed frontier. Inherited little land but an instinct for division. Built power through feuds, shifting alliances, marriages, debts, and whispered promises. By middle age, became indispensable to greater lords who publicly condemned him while privately relying upon. A negotiator of truces that never fully hold, patron of mercenaries, and master of exploiting quarrels between neighboring houses. Chroniclers described him with admiration and unease in the same sentence.

skills.name: Feudal Ledgercraft
skills.description: A practiced ability to track obligations, debts, inheritances, and overlapping claims across multiple lords and institutions.

skills.name: Weaving the Crown's Net
skills.description: Turn a royal suspicion into an actionable threat against any rival noble.

skills.name: Crown Calibration
skills.description: A refined instinct for reading royal intent and adjusting behavior so that royal intervention always works in his favor, even when it appears neutral or punitive.

characters.name: Hugues de Saint-Rémy
characters.description: An aging castellan who took Guillaume in as a page. Taught him discipline, resourcefulness, and the value of peace.

characters.name: King Philippe II
characters.description: The Quiet Architect of Instability. King of France who uses indirect manipulation to maintain control. Uses Guillaume to keep rival barons from consolidating power.

characters.name: Brother Étienne de Vaucelles
characters.description: A papal legate sent to enforce reform. A dangerous figure for Guillaume, as his work turns ambiguous local politics into clear legal or church matters.
